card.name: Dose amounts and quantity phrases
card.fires_on: The last digit of a large dose number, or the word right after it, and words in phrases like "increase in the number of" or "dose per unit". It fires where a quantity or count is being stated.

modes.label: End of dose number
modes.description: Final digit or the bracket or unit right after a large mg, mcg or unit dose.
modes.example: Another patient developed severe muscle cramps after taking 1,60<<0>> mg of imatinib mesylate

modes.label: Number or per-unit phrasing
modes.description: Linking words in phrases about a count or an amount per unit.
modes.example: The pigmentation change is due to increased melanin content in the melanocytes rather than to an increase in the number<< of>> melanocytes.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that ask about a quantity or count, such as "pair" and "how many", and away from "copies" and "distribute".
card.plain: It lights up when the text is giving an amount, like a dose figure or a count of cells.
